description: This file implements a Lasso security guardrail integration for LiteLLM. It manages content moderation, policy enforcement, and masking strategies by calling the external Lasso API. The code includes classes, methods, and logic for API communication, response processing, violation handling, and conversation ID management.

classes.name: LassoResponse
classes.description: TypedDict defining the structure of the response from the Lasso API.

classes.name: LassoGuardrailMissingSecrets
classes.description: Exception raised when the Lasso API key is missing.

classes.name: LassoGuardrailAPIError
classes.description: Exception for errors when calling the Lasso API.

classes.name: LassoGuardrail
classes.description: Main class integrating Lasso API for security guardrails, handling API calls, response processing, masking, and violation enforcement.

methods.description: Generates a ULID or UUID as a unique identifier, fallback if ULID library is unavailable.

methods.description: Pre-call hook for validation and conversation ID management before invoking the LLM.

methods.description: During-call hook for moderation during API request processing.

methods.description: Handles masking logic via the classifix endpoint, applying masked messages if violations occur.

methods.description: Logs details when masking is applied to responses.

methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers for the Lasso API request, including API key and conversation/session IDs.

methods.description: Checks response findings for 'BLOCK' actions to determine if request should be halted.

methods.description: Extracts which deputies were violated from the API response.
